title: Sort a job into a lane
prompt: Job is supplied. Write public static string Lane(Job job). A job with 0 minutes goes to "skip", even when it is urgent. Any other urgent job goes to "now". A job under 30 minutes goes to "quick". Everything else goes to "plan".
hints: Two rules can apply to the same job. Which rule should win for an urgent job with 0 minutes?
The first matching arm wins, so write the arms in the same order as the rules in the prompt.
Use { Minutes: 0 }, then { Urgent: true }, then { Minutes: < 30 }, then _ for everything else.
checkLabels: An urgent job with 0 minutes goes to "skip".
A job with 0 minutes that is not urgent goes to "skip".
An urgent job of 45 minutes goes to "now".
An urgent job of 5 minutes goes to "now".
A job of 29 minutes that is not urgent goes to "quick".
A job of exactly 30 minutes that is not urgent goes to "plan".
A job of 90 minutes that is not urgent goes to "plan".

wrongAnswers.misconception: Tests urgency before the 0-minute rule that should win.

feedback: Find the failing job and read your arms from the top. The first arm that matches decides the lane. Check the order, and the edge at exactly 30 minutes.
